title: Türkiye Bitki DNA Barkod Atlası (Turkey Plant DNA Barcode Atlas)
description: A research atlas that asks whether short DNA barcode regions (rbcL, matK, ITS) can separate the vascular plant species of Turkey. Species names come from WCVP (Kew); sequences come from ENA/INSDC. Success is measured with a threshold-free nearest-neighbour test. BOLD was not searched. Results are estimates without expert verification.
